dropped: Horizon was scheduled to enter production in spring 2026. THE HINGE THIS FILM WAS FIRST BUILT ON, and it cannot be sourced anywhere reachable today. knowledge/texas/APPLICATIONS.md asserts it marked verified with no URL, and the sibling claim on the same line is provably wrong, so that mark is not trustworthy. The film does not assert a broken promise it cannot source.
VISION was in beta testing when it took the title. No source in the set.
Feliciano Giustino is at UT Austin's Oden Institute. Not in any fetched sentence.
The NAMD Vista work concerns glutamate transport. The word appears in no fetched sentence.

Vista has 72 GH200 nodes and 144 Grace Superchip nodes. FALSE. Those are CORES PER NODE. TACC's docs give 600 Grace Hopper nodes and 256 Grace Grace nodes. knowledge/texas/APPLICATIONS.md carries the error marked verified.
Vista delivers 4.1 petaflops CPU and 40.8 petaflops GPU. Not re-verifiable today and inherits the doubt from the node-count error on the same line.

Horizon is 300 petaflops and the largest academic supercomputer in the United States. Not sourced, partly contradicted by TACC's own 160 and 320 petaflop figures, and the superlative is currently false in the only public ranking.
Horizon has 800 GB/sec Infiniband. Almost certainly a garbling of the Quantum-X800 product name, and gigabytes against gigabits is an eightfold error.
Horizon is in Williamson County. True and commonly known, but no fetched sentence on the city page states it, so it is not spoken.

Abilene's projected 1.2 GW equals 1.0 million H100-equivalents. The same page gives an identical gigawattage for another site at 2.5 million, so one of the two is wrong and the page does not say which.
notes: tacc.utexas.edu returns 403 to the fetcher on both system pages while docs.tacc.utexas.edu serves normally, and the operator's live user documentation is the better source anyway. A first-pass fetch of the TOP500 site pages returned a confident rank column that does not exist on those pages, invented by pairing unrelated table values; the second fetch with a literal-extraction prompt showed the real columns. That artifact is recorded because it is exactly what this gate exists to catch.

provenance_numerals._why: Numerals that appear ONLY on the credits card and describe the film's own materials rather than the world. Victor 18956 is a catalogue number, 1923 is the recording's publication year and 1926 is the public domain boundary it clears. They carry their own archive.org URL on the same card. Two scorers each had to decide by hand whether numeral lint reaches them; it should not be a judgement call.

_source_health.note: One source behind 5 of 20 claims is serving an error with no archived copy. Their recorded quotes stand as evidence because they were captured at fetch time, but nothing here had been recording that a source went dark, so a run needing to re-verify one of them discovered it the expensive way.
